hypothesis: The run now dies at Compile, not at runtime: Icarus emits 'constant selects in always_* processes are not currently supported' at two source regions (repeated 8x and 4x). This is not a functional bug in the pipeline; it is a synthesis-style coding pattern that Icarus 12 rejects. The branch predictor and/or cache modules contain hand-unrolled array element accesses with literal indices inside always_ff/always_comb (e.g. btb_valid[0], btb_tag[k], bht[3], tag_array[0], valid_array[2]) used to work around Icarus's lack of variable part-select/array-slice support, or a 16-way prediction/tag mux written as (index==4'd0)? btb_target[0] : ... with constant selects. Icarus treats those constant selects as unsupported in always_* processes, so elaboration aborts with 2 errors before any simulation. The two error sites correspond most plausibly to (a) the BTB/BHT reset or prediction mux in branch_predictor.sv and (b) the cache tag/valid/data array access in icache.sv or dcache.sv. The fix is structural, not semantic: drive the arrays through packed vectors indexed by a variable, or use generate blocks with one always block per element (genvar is constant per instance, but the element access must not be a literal select inside a shared always). No datapath or predictor-training logic needs to change.
